en: A black‑and‑white street view showing early 20th‑century buildings along a cobblestone road. On the left is a rounded corner tower with small windows; in the center a wooden house with large windows and a distinctive enclosed staircase or bay projecting over the sidewalk; farther along stands a plastered building with a domed tower. The view is calm with no visible people or vehicles in motion. The top of the image bears printed captions in two languages.
